properties.headline: Freeze Watch issued November 6 at 12:11AM CST until November 8 at 8:00AM CST by NWS Paducah KY
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Freeze Warning, sub-freezing temperatures as low as
30 expected. For the Freeze Watch, sub-freezing temperatures as low
as 29 possible.

* WHERE...Portions of the Ozark Foothills of southeast Missouri and
south and southwest Illinois.

* WHEN...For the Freeze Warning, from 11 PM this evening to 8 AM CST
Saturday. For the Freeze Watch, from Saturday evening through
Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The hard freezes will bring the growing season
to an end.
properties.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.
